articles.title: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom

articles.title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
articles.summary: Businesses are willing to flop back and forth as each lab releases new models, volatility that should give both companies' investors pause about how "sticky" enterprise AI spending really is.

articles.title: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plug-in
articles.summary: Ever wanted someone else to do your texting for you? ChatGPT is being offered up as an automated text scribe via a new Apple Messages integration.

articles.title: OK, can we actually cool data centers with our pee?
articles.summary: Jason Kelce joked that people should cool data centers with their pee, rather than potable water -- but his suggestion is not completely ludicrous.

articles.title: Google gives publishers a new way to fight AI-driven traffic losses
articles.summary: Google is giving publishers a new button that lets readers make them a preferred source across Search, Discover, and Google News, potentially boosting their traffic as AI search sends fewer clicks to the web.

articles.title: Runlayer, Rippling drop lawsuits — but the brouhaha is still a cautionary tale for founders

articles.title: Linkdaze’s smart calendar is built to run a household, not just track a schedule

articles.title: Ramp launches its own AI model router, called Router
articles.summary: Ramp has launched its own AI model routing service, dubbed Router, that lets users and companies use and switch between various large language models via an API.

articles.title: Meta brings Pocket, an app that lets you vibe-code and share games, to US users
articles.summary: Meta is bringing Pocket, its experimental AI-powered app for creating and sharing interactive games, to users across the U.S. after quietly testing it in Brazil.

articles.title: Inertia Enterprises finds a way to make its fusion fuel fast
articles.summary: Fusion power startup Inertia Enterprises reduced the fuel filling process from a week to just a few hours. It's one of 10 hurdles the company must overcome to make a profitable power plant.

articles.title: Meta AI’s new Mac app wants you to talk to your apps
articles.summary: The company said that the dictation feature works across all apps, just like other tools such as Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, and Monologue.

articles.title: Binance now lets AI agents trade, but keeping them in check is largely up to users
articles.summary: Binance's Agent OS works with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Cursor.

articles.title: Stripe didn’t really buy OpenRouter because of the ‘singularity’
articles.summary: What does a payments giant want with a startup that routes prompts between different AI models? Stripe says it's because of "the singularity" but it's really for a far more real and powerful reason.

articles.title: OpenAI seeks to one-up Anthropic with new customer privacy protections
articles.summary: A competition is developing between OpenAI and Anthropic over who can provide the best privacy protections for enterprise customer data.

articles.title: Cognition CEO denies report that SpaceX tried to acquire the startup
articles.summary: SpaceX was reportedly in talks to buy AI coding startup Cognition. SpaceX has already acquired Cursor as it races to catch up to rivals like OpenAI and Anthropic in enterprise AI.

articles.title: AI was supposed to win people over by now — it hasn’t
articles.summary: As AI becomes harder to avoid, consumers are growing more wary of the technology — and Silicon Valley is discovering that widespread adoption doesn’t necessarily lead to acceptance.

articles.title: Google packs Search and Gemini with new AI study tools
articles.summary: The launch of the new study features marks Google's latest effort to make Gemini the AI assistant that students turn to when learning and studying, as it continues to compete with companies like OpenAI.

articles.title: Researchers say OpenAI revoked their access to limited cyber program
articles.summary: The idea behind OpenAI's Trusted Access for Cyber program is to give trusted defenders better models so they can report bugs and vulnerabilities to companies, with the aim of getting flaws patched faster.

articles.summary: The 78kW facility at Caritas Hospital will support digital services at several hospitals run by the operator in Baden-Württemberg

articles.summary: The most successful data center developers will not be those making the boldest sustainability claims. They will be the ones willing to have those claims independently measured, tested, and verified

articles.summary: Speculation rampant over the identity of the buyer of a plot sold by property developers Krieger Group

articles.title: Duke’s Carolinas resource plan targets 18.5 GW new solar by 2041
articles.summary: The utility’s North Carolina and South Carolina  territory “continues to experience significant growth,” with both states ranked among the fastest-growing, Duke told South Carolina regulators.

articles.title: Electric co-ops press for repeal of gas power plant emissions rules
articles.summary: “We are anxious to see action on this,” said National Rural Electric Cooperative Association CEO Jim Matheson. “We all understand that natural gas is the go-to for new generation in this country.”

articles.title: FERC approves SPP ‘topology optimization’ plan for cutting grid congestion
articles.summary: The Midcontinent Independent System Operator’s power market has saved nearly $100 million this year under a similar approach for topology reconfiguration.

articles.title: VPP value proposition expands to affordability, reliability and resilience
articles.summary: Robust compensation and metering, along with strong customer protections, are needed to drive participation in utility virtual power plants programs, according to experts.

articles.title: Home buyers want more information on energy usage. Utilities can help.
articles.summary: By positioning themselves as trusted experts for both buyers and real estate agents, utilities can speed the adoption of efficient grid technologies, say residential energy experts.

articles.title: The Western energy market must shift as power flows evolve, say experts
articles.summary: The WECC-1 RAS “does not consider south-to-north flows, and frankly, it is something I'm worried about,” said Bonneville Power Administration system dispatcher Chris Sanford during a Western Market Seams workshop.

articles.title: Pennsylvania dangles permitting carrot for data centers that bring their own power
articles.summary: Under a new permitting framework for loads over 25 MW, applicants that commit to abide by the state’s recently introduced infrastructure development standards for data centers will receive preferential treatment.

articles.title: Northwest council proposes 11 GW of new generation, 5 GW storage by 2032
articles.summary: The Northwest Power and Conservation Council estimates the portfolio for its Ninth Power Plan would have a fixed cost of $2.3 billion in 2032.

articles.title: Hyundai unifies vehicle V2X capabilities with AllDayEnergy entity
articles.summary: The global service signals a consistent energy management experience across Hyundai, Kia and Genesis EVs, and better use of bidirectional charging functionality.

articles.title: CAISO’s load-balancing EDAM math doesn’t add up, says CPUC staff
articles.summary: The California Public Utilities Commission’s Energy Division staff asked the California Independent System Operator to publish methodology explaining discrepancies in its public Extended Day-Ahead Market data.

articles.title: Romanian plant taken offline as Hungary moves to keep Paks operating
articles.summary: Romania has taken the second unit of the Cernavoda nuclear power plant offline because of the record-low water level in the River Danube. Meanwhile, the Hungarian government has announced measures to enable the Paks plant to continue operating.

articles.title: Rosatom staff begin returning to Iran's Bushehr nuclear plant
articles.summary: The first five Russian engineering specialists have returned to the Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant in Iran, Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev has said.

articles.title: Changjiang 4 control room commissioned
articles.summary: The main control room of unit 4 at the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's Hainan province has been commissioned ahead of the reactor's start up in early 2027.

articles.title: First criticality for Mochovce 4
articles.summary: Slovakia's newest nuclear power unit, Mochovce 4 has reached critical status and minimum controlled power.

articles.title: Containment of first Egyptian unit takes shape
articles.summary: Concreting work on the fourth tier of the reactor building's inner containment at unit 1 of Egypt's El Dabaa nuclear power plant has been completed, the Nuclear Power Plants Authority announced.

articles.title: First fuel loaded into Tianwan unit 7
articles.summary: The initial loading of fuel assemblies into the core of unit 7 of the Tianwan nuclear power plant has begun. It is the first of two Russian-designed VVER-1200 reactors under construction at the site in China's Jiangsu province.

articles.title: Construction of Bailong 2 conventional island begins
articles.summary: The first concrete pour has been completed for the basemat of the conventional island of unit 2 at the Bailong nuclear power plant in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region of southern China, State Power Investment Corporation announced.

articles.title: CNNC to procure contract for high-temperature reactor
articles.summary: China National Nuclear Corporation plans to soon procure a high-temperature reactor engineering contracting project for the first phase of the Xuwei nuclear power project in China's Jiangsu province.

articles.title: TerraPower expands cooperation with Korean partners
articles.summary: US small modular reactor developer TerraPower has signed agreements with South Korea's Hyundai Engineering & Construction and SK Innovation to develop and commercialise its Natrium reactor technology across the USA, Korea and select international markets.

articles.title: Hot tests completed at third Haiyang unit
articles.summary: Tests that simulate the temperatures and pressures which the reactor systems will be subjected to during normal operation have been completed at unit 3 of the Haiyang nuclear power plant in China's Shandong province, State Power Investment Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Kaleidos microreactor begins journey to Idaho
articles.summary: Radiant's 1 MWe microreactor - which is designed to be transportable - is making the journey from California to the DOME test bed at Idaho National Laboratory on the back of a truck.

articles.title: Passive safety module installed at Zhangzhou 4
articles.summary: The third and final module of the passive reactor cavity water injection tank has been installed in the reactor building of unit 4 of the Zhangzhou nuclear power plant in China's Fujian province, China National Nuclear Corporation announced.

articles.title: Second US port to explore nuclear maritime technologies
articles.summary: The Port of Corpus Christi in Texas has signed an agreement with the US Department of Transportation's Maritime Administration to explore the use of small modular reactors, microgrids, and advanced vessel propulsion systems. The port is also to collaborate with Core Power for a site-specific maritime nuclear readiness study.

articles.title: Newcleo sets out plan for licensing of US MOX plant
articles.summary: France-headquartered innovative nuclear energy company Newcleo has submitted a Regulatory Engagement Plan to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission for its planned mixed-oxide fuel manufacturing facility in the USA.

articles.title: Australian reactor marks 20 years of operations
articles.summary: Australia's nuclear science and technology organisation ANSTO is marking 20 years of operations for its multi-purpose nuclear reactor at Lucas Heights in southern Sydney.

articles.title: Government approves extended operation of Almaraz plant
articles.summary: The Spanish government has granted the renewal of the operating licence for the two-unit Almaraz nuclear power plant until June 2030. Under the country's nuclear phase-out policy, unit 1 was scheduled to shut down in October 2027, with unit 2 following one year later.

articles.title: IAEA sees enhanced safety at Philippine research reactor
articles.summary: The Philippines has made progress in implementing recommendations aimed at strengthening the safe operation of its sole nuclear reactor training facility, the PRR-1 SATER, according to an International Atomic Energy Agency team of experts.

articles.title: India begins public consultation on SHANTI Bill rules
articles.summary: India's Department of Atomic Energy has launched a public consultation on its draft rules and regulations under the 2025 legislation to modernise the country's nuclear legal framework and, amongst other things, enable limited private participation in India's nuclear sector.

articles.title: FANCO advances engagement with regulator on HALEU plant
articles.summary: The company says the US regulator has docketed its regulatory engagement plan for a facility to manufacture ceramic fuel for its EAGL-1 small modular reactor, and plans to submit a construction and operation licence application in 2027.

articles.title: Bruce Power gets go-ahead for isotope processing
articles.summary: Canada's nuclear regulator has authorised Bruce Power to operate the on-site facility to carry out an important step in the production process for lutetium-177, used in the treatment of prostate cancer and in targeted therapies in precision medicine.
